subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THIS ANSWERS THE OPEN QUESTION LEFT BY claim.law.IT_empty-bodied-if-elides-its-own-comparison.20260901.v1, WHICH CLOSED THE EMPTY-BODY AND REDUNDANT-CONDITIONAL-STORE AXES AND CONCLUDED 'the source shape that leaves a stranded compare is still unidentified'. THE SHAPE IS: A GUARD WHOSE BODY WRITES A LOCAL THAT IS NEVER READ AGAIN, WITH THE COMPARISON'S OPERANDS VOLATILE-QUALIFIED. Written as `if (<volatile a> == <volatile b>) { dead++; }` where `dead` is a declared local with no reachable read, MWCC emits the operand loads, the sign/zero extensions and the comparison, then a LATER pass deletes the dead store, which makes both edges of the branch identical and removes the branch -- leaving the already-scheduled compare stranded with no consumer. That is exactly the history the parent law says produces a target dead compare, and it is reachable from portable C.

WHY THE PARENT LAW'S AXES FAILED AND THIS ONE DOES NOT. An EMPTY body is discarded by the FRONT END before any instruction is emitted for the conditional, so the compare never exists (parent law, measured twice). A REDUNDANT-BUT-LIVE store (`selected = 0;` where `selected` is read afterwards) is not dead, so neither the store nor the branch is ever removed and the surplus branch survives (parent law, measured). A DEAD store is the only one of the three that is emitted early and removed late, which is the precise timing the stranded compare requires. Stated as a rule of thumb: the body must be REAL to the front end and DEAD to the optimizer, and only an unread write is both.

THE VOLATILE IS A NECESSARY CO-FACTOR, NOT AN OPTIONAL EXTRA -- THIS IS A TWO-VARIABLE LEVER AND MUST BE PROBED JOINTLY (AGENTS.md residual-work discipline 6). MEASURED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS IN ONE SESSION. On LinkItemTriggers the operands were already `*(volatile s8*)` reads and the dead-counter body took the function from 3 instructions short to instruction-count exact with an IDENTICAL multiset in ONE probe. On AddLocatorInstList, whose guard operand is a plain SDA global (`sLastPlayerStart`) compared against a constant-folded local, the SAME dead-counter body went the WRONG way -- 421 -> 416 against a target of 419, multiset 30t -> 33t -- because with nothing volatile the elision reached the operand loads too, exactly as the parent law's own second measurement predicts. Adding `*(volatile s32*)&sLastPlayerStart` restored the load (416 -> 417) but still produced no compare. So: dead-store body alone is NOT the lever, volatile alone is NOT the lever, and either one probed without the other yields a measured null or a regression. Screen for the volatile operands BEFORE spending the probe.

THE RESIDUAL BOUNDARY, from the AddLocatorInstList negative, which bounds this law rather than weakening it: the joint form still failed there, and the aligned view names why. The target's own stream keeps `mulli r0,r21,12` on a register it has just loaded with the constant 0 (`li r21,0`), i.e. in the target the guarded variable was NEVER constant-propagated, while in our build it provably is. Where the compared value is a compile-time constant on our side, constant folding removes the comparison ahead of every pass this law depends on, and no body shape can restore it. PRECONDITION, therefore: the comparison must be between two values the optimizer treats as UNKNOWN at that point. Volatile supplies that on the loaded side; it cannot supply it on a side our own source has already pinned to a constant.

SECOND-ORDER PAYOFF, worth stating because it is where most of the score came from. Closing the count gap converted the residual from STRUCTURAL to a CLEAN-RENAMING recolor -- regnorm reported 0 STRUCTURAL, 0 unpaired and a perfectly consistent 2-cycle (r29 -> r30 x16, r30 -> r29 x15, every other register identity). A fully consistent regnorm cycle of that shape is then closable at SOURCE level by declaration order under claim.law.declaration-order-numbers-the-registers-assignment-order-schedules-the-loads.20260901.v1: swapping the counter ahead of the pointer in each of the two affected declaration blocks took real 54 -> 26 -> 0. The general lesson is the ordering of work: fix the instruction-count/structural gap FIRST, re-run regnorm, and only then read the recolor -- a recolor map measured across a count mismatch is not the map you will have to close.
